name: Camp E'thok
summary: In northwestern Thousand Needles, caravans risk ambush below Camp E'thok. Galak centaur hunt travelers in the canyon.

sections.title: A Galak Stronghold
sections.body: Galak centaur hunt travelers in the canyon at Camp E'thok. Their camp lies in northwestern Thousand Needles. From there, the clan ambushes merchant caravans crossing the riverbed below. One caravan carried the goblin Wizlo Bearingshiner. The centaur seized its goods, but Wizlo's fierce pet panther kept his prized gadget beyond their reach.

faq.answer: The Galak clan of centaur lives at Camp E'thok. The aggressive tribe dominates parts of northwestern Thousand Needles.

faq.q: What happened to Wizlo Bearingshiner here?
aliases: what did centaur steal from wizlo
faq.answer: Galak centaur from Camp E'thok ambushed Wizlo Bearingshiner's caravan and seized its goods. They could not take his prized gadget, secured around the collar of his fierce pet panther.
Camp E'thok lies in northwestern Thousand Needles along the base of the canyon walls.

angles.text: As a tauren, you may recall the ancestral war between tauren and centaur across southern Kalimdor when you see the Galak centaur's aggression at Camp E'thok.
